gagasan.nama: [1H] Peluncuran perpetual USDⓈ-M Binance untuk koin yang SUDAH lama ada di spot: jendela hindari 'sell the news'
[1W] Falling Wedge/Symmetrical Triangle 1W (modul pola bot dijalankan di lilin mingguan) pada semesta spot penuh termasuk koin delist
[1W] Faktor dollar volume PRCVOL (Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu, 'Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency', Journal of Finance 2022): beli kuintil dollar volume TERENDAH tiap minggu
gagasan.klaim: The claim is that Binance spot USDT coins in the LOWEST dollar-volume quintile of the formation week (Q1 PRCVOL, Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu JF 2022) beat the equal-weight basket of all eligible coins from the same week by at least +0.5%/week net of costs over the following week. Equal weighting is a stated deviation from the paper, which weights by market cap. Rules are locked: rank by log(weekly quoteVolum
gagasan.patokan: The main benchmark is an equal-weight basket of ALL eligible coins from the same week (same universe, same cost formula), because Q1 is a 20% filter of that basket. Q5 and Q1-Q5 are reported as secondary benchmarks. Main null: shuffle the quintile labels within each week 1000x with seed 20261004; th
gagasan.ambang: LOLOS requires ALL of the following: (1) S = mean weekly Q1 - market, net, at least +0.005 combined; (2) main null p < 0.0455; (3) S > 0 in I1 AND in I2, each with at least 30 weeks and a median of at least 30 coins per quintile; (4) coin-block p < 0.0455; (5) decoy lands at 0.05 < p < 0.95; (6) the -50% delist sensitivity does not flip the sign; (7) winsorizing at 1%/99% does not flip the sign. penantang.alasan: Di kertas, sinyal AI 4H (diskresi Claude) 40 trade tutup avg -0.13R (menang 35%) sedangkan pola 4H 21 tutup avg +0.61R; mekanisme: AI 4H tidak punya aturan teruji/pra-daftar (diskresi murni) sehingga menambah trade tanpa edge dan ongkos. Membuang ~53% trade; n pola masih kecil, keunggulan pola di kertas bisa rezim bull 09-10.
